subject.title: Feature: Per-mention model routing + context window for group mentions

question: Should OpenClaw add mention-state-aware group model routing, and should that be a WhatsApp-specific config surface or a generic channel/plugin SDK contract?
rationale: The request changes public config, provider/model selection, and privacy boundaries for unmentioned shared-room traffic, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product and security contract.

options.title: Design a generic channel contract
options.body: Add a cross-channel/plugin SDK design for mention-state routing and context sizing, then implement WhatsApp through that contract with security and precedence tests.

options.title: Add narrow WhatsApp knobs
options.body: Add `mentionModel`, `backgroundModel`, and `mentionContextMessages` only to WhatsApp, accepting a faster path with more channel-specific config debt.

options.title: Defer to existing ambient modes
options.body: Keep `channels.modelByChannel` and ambient-room-event surfaces as the supported alternatives, and document that they do not provide WhatsApp `requireMention` background routing.

recommendation.title: Design a generic channel contract
recommendation.body: Add a cross-channel/plugin SDK design for mention-state routing and context sizing, then implement WhatsApp through that contract with security and precedence tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the central WhatsApp gating/schema paths and already reviewed this issue's exact remaining gap.
